propositions: Four graph functions carry moderate cyclomatic complexity (CCN 16-22) due to hand-rolled query logic and duplicated reduce-all loops.

The exact reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index pattern is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, and BFS skeletons are re-implemented in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level.
Refactor by extracting two shared helpers: load_indexed_states (for the duplicated load pattern) and bfs (accumulator-based skeleton), ensuring node-sets and traversal results remain unchanged.

After refactoring, all four functions must measure CCN ≤ 7-12 (within new baselines), pass all existing tests without modification, and include a new characterization test for the accumulator-vs-visited distinction.

The refactor is conservative and behavior-preserving: _ready.py, _status.py::_get_ticket_status, and batch_close_operations remain untouched; only the four named functions and their test suite are modified.
